title: Import routes

hint.selectInput: Select a GPX, KML, or GeoJSON file containing tracks or routes. Supported extensions: {{extensions}}
hint.fileLimit: Limits the number of imported files. 0 = no limit.
hint.titleRegex: Extracts the track title from the filename using a capture group. The first captured group becomes the title.
hint.titleMode:
Controls how track titles are determined:

Empty — no title is set.

Filename (without extension) — uses the filename, stripped of its extension.

Filename (with extension) — uses the full filename.

Name property — uses the name/title stored in the file's metadata (e.g. GPX <name> or GeoJSON properties.name). Falls back to empty if missing.

Regex on filename — extracts the title from the filename using a regular expression with a capture group. Falls back to empty if the regex doesn't match.
hint.tagMode: How tags are assigned: none, pick from existing tags, or extract via regex from the filename.
hint.tagRegex: Extracts tags from the filename using capture groups. Use /pattern/g for multiple matches.
hint.dryRun: Preview only — no tracks are written to the database.
hint.keepAppActive: Shows a notification and prevents the system from stopping the import when switching between apps
hint.autoCustomDate: Extracts a date from the filename using the configured patterns and sets it as the track's custom date.
hint.mergeMode: When enabled, all tracks from the same file are merged into a single route. Tracks are not merged across files. Each file is treated individually.
hint.overwriteMode: Compared by source file path. "Overwrite" updates geometry and title in place. "Skip" keeps existing tracks untouched.
hint.addPattern: A date pattern extracts a date from filenames. The regex captures the date text, the format tells us how to parse it. Patterns are tried in order — the first match wins.
hint.datePatternLabel: A short description to identify this pattern in the list.
hint.datePatternRegex: A regular expression with one capture group. The captured text is parsed as a date.
hint.datePatternFormat: A Day.js format string that describes how to read the captured text. E.g. DD.MM.YYYY for European dates, YYYY-MM-DD for ISO.

noFeatures: No tracks or routes found in the file.
dirNoFiles: No supported files found in this directory.
dirHint: For large file sets, using an app directory is recommended for faster scanning
mergeMode: Merge all tracks into a single route
skippedGeometry: {{count}} track(s) skipped due to missing geometry data
regexExpensive: This pattern may cause slow performance
regexNoCaptureGroup: This pattern has no capture group and will not extract a date.
